About Me

A quick glimpse into my background & passion

I'm a third-year Computer Science student specializing in Software Engineering at Ahram Canadian University (ACU). My primary focus is on mobile application development using Flutter & Dart. I specialize in building responsive user interfaces, managing app state, integrating REST APIs, and storing data locally using SQLite & Hive. I love continuous learning, solving algorithmic challenges, and transforming Figma designs into fully functioning mobile apps.
